title: Nvidia Introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang for Workaround on U.S. Export Controls
summary: Nvidia’s sales team introduced Chinese tech giant Alibaba to Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy involved in smuggling Nvidia chips into China, months before U.S. export controls on advanced semiconductors came into effect in 2022, according to three people with direct knowledge of the matter.Nvidia’s introductions, which happened on two occasions across several months in 2022, helped Huang and her company land Alibaba as a customer, two of the three people said. From there on, Huang, a newcomer to the chip renting business, was able to get bank loans that helped finance the purchase of Nvidia chips, the two people said.

bajada_en: According to The Information, NVIDIA's sales team introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang, allegedly involved in smuggling chips to China before 2022 export controls. The connection helped Huang secure bank financing.

title: Nvidia’s Board Rebuffs Jensen
summary: Well, that was embarrassing. A few hours after Nvidia’s recently departed CEO Jensen Huang issued aplaintive statementsaying he’d love his job back, company chair Harvey Jones sent back a message: no chance, buddy. In an unusual appearance on the company’s earnings call Tuesday afternoon, Jones stated unequivocally that the board “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO.”Jones also added something the board didn’t say when it announced Huang’s exit last Thursday: that the exit came “after disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company’s code of conduct, standards and cultural norms.” So now it’s clear: itwasHuang’s affairs (with a subordinate and a business partner) that caused his exit, and not, for instance,concerns about Nvidia’s possible involvementin smuggling of its chips into China.
title_es: NVIDIA revela motivo real de salida de Jensen Huang
bajada: La junta de NVIDIA reveló que Jensen Huang fue desvinculado por 'conducta personal inconsistente' con códigos de conducta, refiriéndose a asuntos extramaritales con una subordinada y socia comercial. Esto aclaró que no fueron problemas operacionales o de compliance en exportaciones.
bajada_en: NVIDIA's board revealed Jensen Huang was removed for 'personal behavior inconsistent' with conduct codes, referring to affairs with a subordinate and business partner. This clarified operational or export compliance weren't the issue.

title: alibaba /open-code-review
summary: OpenCodeReview English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. Visit the official website for more details. Benchmark Compared to general-purpose agents (Claude Code), Open Code Review achieves significantly higher Precision and F1 with the same underlying model, while consuming only ~1/9 of the tokens and completing reviews faster. Note that its Recall is lower than general-purpose agents — a deliberate trade-off favoring precision over noise. A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues). Explore the AACR-Bench dataset on Hugging Face . Metric What it measures Why it matters F1 Harmonic mean of precision and recall Best single number for overall review quality Precision Proportion of reported issues that are real defects Higher = fewer false alarms to triage Recall Proportion of real defects that are found Higher = fewer issues slip through review Avg Time Wall-clock time per review Matters for CI pipeline latency Avg Token Total
title_es: Alibaba abre OpenCodeReview: herramienta IA para revisión de código
bajada: Alibaba liberó OpenCodeReview, una herramienta CLI de revisión de código impulsada por IA que probó internamente durante dos años. Identifica millones de defectos y usa agentes LLM con capacidades de tool-use para análisis de precisión a nivel de línea.
bajada_en: Alibaba released OpenCodeReview, an AI-powered code review CLI tool tested internally for two years. It identifies millions of defects and uses LLM agents with tool-use capabilities for line-level precision analysis.

title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
summary:
arXiv:2611.18747v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.
title_es: Paper: Agentes de IA aprenden usando audio-visual de videos
bajada: Investigadores presentaron VEX, un framework que usa comprensión audio-visual para entrenar agentes que usan computadora. El método permite al agente aprender de videos tutoriales y verificar su progreso, mejorando sobre enfoques basados en screenshots.
bajada_en: Researchers presented VEX, a framework using audio-visual understanding to train computer-use agents. The method lets agents learn from tutorial videos and verify progress, improving over screenshot-based approaches.
